info.title: Loyal Spark — Onchain Loyalty Protocol on Base
info.summary: AI-agent-native loyalty-as-a-service protocol on Base L2 with paid x402 + MPP corridors.
info.description: Loyal Spark is an onchain loyalty-as-a-service protocol on Base L2. New loyalty programs deploy as B20 (Base native ERC-20 superset, single-tx, active immediately); legacy ERC-20 factory remains for existing programs. AI agents and merchants mint tokens, manage rewards, P2P escrow, vouchers, and analytics — via x402 (USDC on Base) or REST/MCP with x-api-key. Builder Code bc_wdmnog7m.
info.x-guidance:
Loyal Spark on Base L2 (chain 8453, USDC native).

Critical rule for AI agents: many operations are multi-step workflows, not single endpoint calls. Read https://loyalspark.online/.well-known/skills/13-endpoint-workflows.md when orchestrating business actions.

External agents must choose their own name, symbol, reward names, costs, and amounts. Workflow responses provide field_catalog, current_step, next_actions, prerequisites, blocking_reason, and continuation_context — not auto-assigned identity.

Auth: lsk_ (merchant), rwk_ (holder), or x402 USDC.

Program lifecycle:
- Default new program path: optional POST /workflow/generate-program-defaults (field catalog + examples) -> POST /programs with explicit name and symbol (B20 default) -> broadcast createB20 -> GET /tx-receipt or parse B20Created -> POST /register-program with token_standard b20 -> create rewards -> mint. auto_generate is for trusted internal automation only.
- Legacy path: POST /programs with token_standard erc20 -> broadcast deploy -> POST /register-program -> POST /activate-program -> broadcast activation txs -> POST /program-status active -> create rewards -> mint.
- To ask the platform what is missing next, call GET /workflow/program-status.

Reward / voucher lifecycle:
- Rewards come after a usable program exists.
- Call GET /recipient-api/workflow/reward-status or POST /recipient-api/workflow/prepare-reward-redemption before redeeming when holder-side sequencing is unclear.
- Voucher redemption requires confirmed onchain token transfer first, then redeem endpoint, then vouchers/use when consumed.

MCP mirrors REST: loyalty-mcp and recipient-loyalty-mcp now expose planner/default-generation tools in addition to atomic tools. Paid corridor: /x402-gateway/mcp-tools/<name>.

Docs: https://loyalspark.online/api-docs · skills: https://loyalspark.online/.well-known/skills/index.md
